bot.start.title:
Welcome to the AI Agent 🤖
Connect AI providers, browse models, and use them from Telegram.
bot.help:
Commands: /start /help /settings /providers /models
Add a provider, select a model, then open a new chat. Use /cancel to cancel input.
common.soon: This feature will be available in a later stage.
provider.name: Send the provider name
provider.token: Send the API token in this private chat. I will attempt to delete your message after receiving it.
provider.headers.ask: Does this provider need additional headers?
provider.headers.input: Send headers as a JSON object. They will not be displayed after saving.
provider.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this provider?
chat.ready: Send a message. Each message is sent independently to the active model. Provider charges may apply.
model.test.warning: A small test will be sent to the provider and may incur a charge. Continue?
error.OFFLINE: Could not connect to the provider.
error.AUTH_FAILED: The key is invalid or lacks permission.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Rate limit reached. Try again later.
error.INVALID_RESPONSE: Could not interpret the provider response.
error.UNSUPPORTED: Automatic model discovery is unavailable or the operation is unsupported.
error.INVALID_URL: Invalid URL or blocked network destination.
error.NOT_FOUND: The item does not exist or you do not have access.
error.DISABLED: The provider is disabled or the model is no longer available.
error.NO_ACTIVE_MODEL: Select an active model from the model menu first.
error.INTERNAL: Could not complete the operation. Try again later.
files.prompt: Send a file or project archive as a document. Content is never executed automatically.
project.search_prompt: Send the text to search for.
project.question_prompt: Write your question about the project.
project.delete_confirm: Delete this project workspace and its files?
error.PATH_DENIED: Path access denied for security reasons.
error.EXTRACTED_TOO_LARGE: Extracted size exceeds the safe limit.
error.FILE_TOO_LARGE: File exceeds the safe size limit.
error.TOO_MANY_FILES: The project contains too many files.
error.INVALID_ARCHIVE: Could not safely read the archive.
error.INVALID_DOCUMENT: Invalid document or document safety limit exceeded.
error.BINARY_FILE: This file cannot be displayed as text.
